caption: Cellebroederspoort, Kampen
composition: Land gate with two spired towers from the park side · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Cellebroederspoort at Kampen is a brick land gate. A rectangular middle under a wolf roof sits between two towers whose lower parts are round and whose upper stages are fourteen-sided, each with a tall spire. It is overcast, about 12.1°C, with wind near 7.2 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. The carved lions and the year are not readable. The Koornmarktspoort is the river gate and is not this frame.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Cellebroederspoort in Kampen at night

qc_notes.note: Gate 1 hold (Cosmo QC 2026-09-26, verified by Cosmo's own read of the 16:9 master): the scene does not recognizably depict the Cellebroederspoort at Kampen — the master shows a floodlit double-tower castle gatehouse with two tall spired round towers flanking a central arched block, while the Cellebroederspoort is a single plain brick medieval tower gate; the evidence card's own geometry anchors ('two brick towers with tall spires') contradict the documented site. Hold until the builder re-renders the single-tower gate and re-pushes.
